manifest.name: custom-field-value
manifest.description: One customer's value for one operator-defined property (backlog:434cc39a): the per-subject row beside the contact or company record, keyed by subject and field key. One row per subject and field: setting the same field again rewrites the value (an edit), never a second row. Values are operator-entered or human-confirmed AI proposals; the definition owns the type and every write is validated against it.
